decisions.decision: Archetype is product. npm package detangler plus FilePress marketing site at detangler.dev, sibling of aiBreze.
decisions.rationale: User staked the npm name and registered the domain. Same distribution shape as aiBreze: installable package, skill folder, public site.

decisions.decision: v1 is report-only. Apply is designed for but ships second.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS: comb first, work the knots later. Trust the fixture corpus before rewriting documents.
alternatives_considered: Ship apply in the same release

decisions.decision: No PocketBase, no auth, no accounts. Local CLI plus static FilePress site.
decisions.rationale: State is the user's document and the run artifacts on disk. Nothing needs to outlive the browser or sync across devices.

decisions.decision: Implementation language is TypeScript ESM on Node 20+, pnpm, matching aiBreze and house rules. GENESIS skill-layout Python names are illustrative, not the stack.
decisions.rationale: House rule: TypeScript ESM for all Node application and script code. Sibling package is already this stack.
alternatives_considered: Python skill scripts as sketched in GENESIS §9

decisions.decision: Phase 2 exit criteria rewritten for a CLI + static site (fixture report, artifact files, FilePress preview) instead of web-app CRUD.
decisions.rationale: Default tracking template assumes a PocketBase web app. Detangler is a local package.
alternatives_considered: Leave CRUD wording and mark N/A later

decisions.decision: Pruned Phase 7 auth-flow and payment-flow exit criteria. Revisit if a paid tier appears.
decisions.rationale: v1 is a free npm package and static site. No accounts, no checkout.
alternatives_considered: Keep payment criteria as a reminder

decisions.decision: Model-assisted stages are hybrid: CLI always runs deterministic stages; spine, term-dependency, and same-claim wait for an agent or an optional user key.
decisions.rationale: User chose A. Documents may be confidential; no project-owned cloud key in the published package.
alternatives_considered: CLI always requires an API key
Skill-only; npx stays deterministic with no stubs

decisions.rationale: User confirmed the same org as aiBreze.

decisions.decision: spine_weak (partial) is off in the default report.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS recommendation: it generates the most noise.

decisions.decision: LocalBerth lease is detangler-site on 5199. site:dev reads the lease and passes --port to FilePress.
decisions.rationale: 5182 is ollanet-site. Claiming a port without binding FilePress to it is not a lease.
alternatives_considered: Let FilePress pick a random port

decisions.decision: apply ships in this release as prompt and skill guidance. The CLI writes apply.md and does not rewrite the draft. detangler-apply works only approved findings.
decisions.rationale: User: the idea is not to apply the report automatically; it is to give the prompt/skill guidance to apply a report, and that belongs in this release.
alternatives_considered: Keep apply as later automatic rewrite

gotchas.issue: Named-section regex that allows any Title-case run before the word 'section' matches clauses like 'See Section 2 for the hook that this section' and 'If a section'.
gotchas.resolution: Require '[Tt]he Title Case Name section'. Keep Section N on the numbered pattern.

gotchas.issue: FilePress 0.1.9 build fails if site/posts is missing, and prerender fails without static/favicon.svg.
gotchas.resolution: Always ship a posts/ folder (even one post) and favicon.svg. Docs mount 404s during prerender are warnings; /docs works after mount.

gotchas.issue: 5182 is already leased to ollanet-site. ensure-lease claimed 5182 in the script but never passed --port to FilePress, so preview landed on a random port.
gotchas.resolution: Claim detangler-site on 5199. site-dev.mjs prints the lease port and starts filepress dev --port <lease>.

gotchas.issue: Sentence splitter ate heading lines (no period), so near-verbatim pairs included heading tokens and missed stale-fact.
gotchas.resolution: Blank heading lines in a length-preserving copy before sentence matching so offsets stay valid.
